# Team STEP

> Independent game studio. One step at a time.

Team STEP is an independent game studio building the home for the indie game world. Current project: **Meltdown** (nuclear reactor management sim). Earlier: **Witch One: Crucible** (action roguelite).

## Games

- [Meltdown](https://teamstep.io/games/meltdown/): Manage an overworked reactor, keep the city powered, try not to cause a meltdown. Steam wishlist + demo, itch.io demo.
- [Witch One: Crucible](https://teamstep.io/games/witch-one-crucible/): A magic assassin adventure to save the kingdom. On itch.io.
